description: This file defines the RecycleBinClient class for interacting with the Amazon Recycle Bin service in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various operations like creating, deleting, listing, and updating rules related to the recycle bin.

classes.name: RecycleBinClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with Amazon Recycle Bin service, extending AwsClient with dedicated methods for recycle bin operations.

methods.name: createRule
methods.description: Creates a new recycle bin rule.

methods.name: createRuleAsync
methods.description: Creates a new recycle bin rule asynchronously.

methods.name: deleteRule
methods.description: Deletes a specified recycle bin rule.

methods.name: deleteRuleAsync
methods.description: Deletes a recycle bin rule asynchronously.

methods.name: getRule
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific recycle bin rule.

methods.name: getRuleAsync
methods.description: Retrieves details of a recycle bin rule asynchronously.

methods.name: listRules
methods.description: Lists all recycle bin rules.

methods.name: listRulesAsync
methods.description: Lists all recycle bin rules asynchronously.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Lists tags for a resource asynchronously.

methods.name: lockRule
methods.description: Locks a recycle bin rule to prevent modifications.

methods.name: lockRuleAsync
methods.description: Locks a recycle bin rule asynchronously.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Adds tags to a resource asynchronously.

methods.name: unlockRule
methods.description: Unlocks a recycle bin rule.

methods.name: unlockRuleAsync
methods.description: Unlocks a recycle bin rule asynchronously.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource asynchronously.

methods.name: updateRule
methods.description: Updates an existing recycle bin rule.

methods.name: updateRuleAsync
methods.description: Updates a recycle bin rule asynchronously.
